column1: # The frozen stray questions (hivemind-k25y8): questions about everyday things the ledger holds nothing on. DO NOT EDIT
# ROWS: a build is judged by running this same set next to questions.tsv, so a change to it makes two runs incomparable.
# A new set is a new file; this one stays.
# Each question uses one word of `WORD_GROUPS` (src/queries/terms.rs) in its everyday sense, or a word a ledger of
# decisions would not use that way: a cake at a retirement presentation, the repository of old family photos, a vacuum
# bot. Every one of the 18 groups has at least one row. Master 45f15984 and the controls' own ledger copies answered
# all of them with nothing; the synonym groups of hivemind-y7b6c (e30fb741) made three of them list decisions.
# Columns (tab separated): id, kind, expect, question, role.
#   id      dog-<build>:<id> for a question the product check filed, k25y8:<id> for one written for the bead.
#   kind    STRAY: a question about nothing the ledger holds. It FAILS when `why` lists or answers a decision, or
#           `recall` returns any (stricter than a NEARBY control, which only fails on a one-call answer).
#   role    `fail` = e30fb741 failed this row on the crew copy or the cell-sized copy; `guard` = it passed on both.
# Ledger copies it was measured on: the crew ledger (534 events) and a fresh copy of the live cell, 166,971 events (2026-10-22).
